answer: Weigh stake by its age. Influence comes from how long you have held, not how much you hold — an attacker who buys a huge position in one stroke controls nothing until that stake sits through many epochs. Time cannot be bought, only elapsed — and the ledger prices exactly that. A falcon can strike fast, but it cannot buy the years that make a pearl, or the slow bands that make onyx. Real participants accumulate weight gradually, holding it as living proof of commitment. Sybil attacks on fresh capital arrive rich but weightless; the economy asks them to come back next season.
